description: Capability set for the dedicated native call window built in commands/calls.rs (label `call`, entry call.html / src/call/main.ts, US-016). Least privilege for exactly what that entry does: core:default covers the custom calls_* application commands (custom commands need no per-command ACL token on this app — see the default capability's own note); core:event:default carries the window-scoped `calls:target` / `calls:dispose` messages and, from US-017, the account-scoped `auth:session-changed` envelope this window binds its identity, device key and media to (all emit_to, never a global broadcast; the envelope carries an account id, a generation and a status — never bearer material). US-017 also invokes the existing auth commands `get_auth_session` (the generation this window binds to) and `whoami` / `get_auth_state` through the platform adapter's IdentityApi, to resolve the canonical `prs_` person before any join — all custom commands, so all covered by core:default; core:window:allow-close + allow-destroy + allow-set-focus back the leave-then-close path and duplicate-open focus. allow-destroy is REQUIRED, not belt-and-braces: the close handler calls preventDefault() so teardown can finish and then destroys the window itself, and core:window:default carries only read-only getters, so without this grant the destroy is denied by the ACL and the window can never be closed at all — the same silent UnhandledRejection class as the start-dragging case below; core:window:allow-start-dragging is required because the call shell header is a data-tauri-drag-region (without it wry's start_dragging invoke is denied by the ACL and surfaces as an UnhandledRejection — same failure as HQ-SYNC-WEB-3 on activity-log). A denied microphone or camera also invokes `permissions_open_settings` (another custom command, so also covered by core:default) to deep-link the OS Privacy pane; it spawns `open` in Rust and needs no shell plugin grant here. Deliberately NOT granted: http, shell, fs, notification, global-shortcut, set-size, app theme. The call window never fetches directly (hq-pro traffic goes through the native hq_pro_fetch seam) and never receives credential material.
